----Respondents For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Nrapan Shankar Acharya
For Respondent(s) : Mr. Salim Khan Mehar, PP  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MADAN GOPAL VYAS Order 15/03/2024

The present criminal miscellaneous petition under Section 482 of CrPC has been filed by the petitioners for quashing of the FIR No. 48/2024 dated 06.02.2024 registered at Police Station- Mahila Thana, Bikaner for the offences under Sections 498A, 406 and 323 of IPC.
2.

While relying upon the factual report dated 14.03.2024, learned Public Prosecutor submits that the Investigating Agency prima facie found that against the petitioner No.1, offences under [2024:RJ-JD:12452] (2 of 2) [CRLMP-1675/2024] Section 498A, 406 and 323 of IPC are made out.
However, for petitioner Nos. 2 and 3, the Investigating Agency found that no offences are made out against them.
